hypothesis: C69 action-only s20000 exceeds C58b FastWAM s10000 by at least 3 percentage points on the identical 680-state paired LIBERO grid, with at least 20 net wins, one-sided exact McNemar p at most 0.05, and no suite below -3 percentage points.
single_variable: The paired evaluator changes only the restored endpoint arm between C58b and C69 for each fixed suite/task/trial state. The endpoints bundle different training histories, so this ranks complete endpoints and does not identify a causal training mechanism.
parent_baseline: C58b FastWAM s10000 checkpoint SHA256 2e6294712f7944037c3982ae7e6b8b87adbdaab190e1972ff4a3d592cc99e541 was the formal closed-loop champion and is the fixed direct control.

architecture.paper: Evaluate a fixed world-action policy checkpoint in closed loop.
architecture.upstream_code: FastWAM restores a policy checkpoint without evaluator-time training.
architecture.local: C58b SHA256 2e629471 and C69 SHA256 20914729 are restored in fresh isolated policy processes for every episode.
architecture.rationale: No model parameter is mutated by this evaluation.

data.paper: Closed-loop benchmark success is evaluated over official task initial states.
data.upstream_code: LIBERO selects task init states by trial index.
data.local: Four suites, ten tasks and trials 33 through 49 form 680 state pairs and 1360 immutable manifest jobs.
data.rationale: The final aggregator rejects missing pairs and initial-state mismatches.

action.paper: Use receding-horizon 7D actions in closed loop.
action.upstream_code: FastWAM executes action chunks under a fixed normalization and replanning policy.
action.local: Both arms use max400, wait30, replan8, horizon32, normalized pre-clamp, binarized gripper and no temporal ensemble.
action.rationale: Only the endpoint arm differs within a pair.

objective.paper: Rank policies by environment task success.
objective.upstream_code: LIBERO env.check_success supplies the closed-loop outcome.
objective.local: Optimizer steps, training samples and effective epochs are all zero; the endpoint is paired task success.
objective.rationale: No offline loss can promote either arm.

optimization.paper: Not applicable to read-only checkpoint evaluation.
optimization.upstream_code: Not applicable to read-only checkpoint evaluation.
optimization.local: Forty A800 GPUs score 1360 isolated episodes; the preregistered maximum is 680000 policy model evaluations and zero optimizer work.
evidence: five shards times eight GPUs; model_evaluations=10; at most 50 replans per episode
optimization.rationale: Evaluation resource accounting replaces a training optimization schedule.

evaluation.paper: Closed-loop success is the primary policy metric.
evaluation.upstream_code: Each LIBERO episode yields a binary success outcome.
evaluation.local: Promotion requires delta >=3pp, net wins >=20, one-sided exact McNemar p <=0.05 and every suite delta >=-3pp.
evaluation.rationale: The paired directional gates are stricter than reporting an unpaired mean success rate.

evidence: Immutable rollout snapshot and SOURCE_FREEZE hash verified by every launcher.
Both endpoint checkpoint hashes are verified before launch.
Immutable 1360-job manifest hash verified before launch.
One shared launcher constructs both arms from the same common action arguments.
Evaluation-only: no optimizer or training sample is consumed.
Five fixed shards, eight GPUs per shard, one isolated job process at a time per worker.
Aggregator requires all five completion markers and all 680 exact pairs.
Not applicable by contract: frozen inference endpoints and optimizer_steps=0.
Trial33 reproduced 40/40 historical binary outcomes for both endpoints.
Trial33 first actions and outcomes reproduced from both frozen checkpoints.
C58b historical 295/680 carrier-track champion is fixed as control.
The fixed endpoint comparison produced a paired +6.3235pp effect; this gate supports endpoint ranking only and does not attribute a causal training mechanism.
All 680 exact pairs completed: C69 338, C58b 295, 79:36 discordant wins, one-sided p=3.758229483222293e-05, and all four directional gates passed.

decision.rationale: The complete fresh-process direct rerun reproduced the historical 338/680 versus 295/680 endpoint result and passed the preregistered overall delta, net wins, one-sided McNemar and suite-floor gates. C69 is promoted as the project closed-loop action/carrier endpoint under this benchmark contract; unseen-state generalization and causal mechanism attribution remain outside the claim.
